mintAuthority.summary: sUSDD has independent native issuance on Ethereum and BNB Chain through immutable SavingsUsdd ERC-4626 wrappers. Each wrapper mints shares only against deposits of its chain-local USDD and burns shares on withdrawal; inherited USDD Join and GovActionsProxy authority is enumerated below and remains Mint Authority, not Bridge Risk.

controls.label: sUSDD Ethereum wrapper (SavingsUsdd, immutable)
controls.capDescription: Immutable DSR-style savings wrapper over deposited USDD; no admin, no proxy, no upgrade path. Shares minted/burned only by deposit/withdraw.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095796 on 2026-10-01, name() = Savings Usdd, symbol() = sUSDD, asset() = 0x4f8e5de400de08b164e7421b3ee387f461becd1a, and usddJoin() = 0x983dfef6d71862d809e239845da5a959492f63b8. The EIP-1967 implementation slot was zero and owner() reverted, reconfirming the prior block 25771107 observation. Verified SavingsUsdd source has no owner, role admin, pause or upgrade path; shares mint against deposits and burn on withdrawal.

controls.label: sUSDD BNB Chain wrapper (SavingsUsdd, immutable)
controls.capDescription: Immutable DSR-style savings wrapper over deposited BNB Chain USDD; no admin, no proxy, no upgrade path. Shares minted/burned only by deposit/withdraw.
controls.evidence: At BSC block 125055874 on 2026-10-01, name() = Savings Usdd, symbol() = sUSDD, asset() = 0x45e51bc23d592eb2dba86da3985299f7895d66ba, and usddJoin() = 0x6b00039d76795fd59baf17e0c9c6d87011e7edac. The EIP-1967 implementation slot was zero and owner() reverted, reconfirming the prior block 116365577 observation. Verified SavingsUsdd source has no owner, role admin, pause or upgrade path; shares mint against local USDD deposits and burn on withdrawal.

controls.label: Inherited USDD Ethereum Join (active ward / direct minter)
controls.capDescription: UsddJoin.exit first executes vat.move(msg.sender,address(this),ONE*wad) and only then calls usdd.mint. The Join therefore requires pre-existing Vat credit and cannot authorize itself or raise a Vat debt ceiling.

sources.label: Sourcify verified Ethereum USDD Join source

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095796 on 2026-10-01, wrapper.usddJoin() resolves this Join (the prior addressed control incorrectly used the USDD token address). token.wards(Join) = 1, Join.usdd() = 0x4f8e5de400de08b164e7421b3ee387f461becd1a, and Join.live() = 1. Verified exit() consumes existing Vat credit before minting; this remains inherited native USDD mint authority, not a bridge.

controls.label: Inherited USDD Ethereum GovActionsProxy (governance executor)
controls.capDescription: The DSAuth-controlled executor can call rely to authorize new token or Vat wards, file to raise system ceilings, and customExec for arbitrary system calls. Its Pause delay is zero.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095796 on 2026-10-01, authority() = zero, owner() = 0x25198d0d111eeac0fb1bd1de826294d9fce84378, and Pause 0xca277750ecd2b0707a7ccef2a78ec2f33b5fc7f7 delay() = zero, reconfirming block 25711756. Verified source exposes authenticated rely, file and customExec paths; inherited parent authority remains immediately governed.

controls.label: Inherited USDD Ethereum GovActionsProxy owner EOA
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095796 on 2026-10-01, GovActionsProxy.owner() = this address, authority() = zero and eth_getCode = 0x, reconfirming block 25711756. Verified DSAuth gives this EOA immediate governance paths that can authorize mint rails or remove system limits.

review.evidence: Reviewed 2026-08-16: Ethereum block 25771107 and BSC block 116365577 confirm that both sUSDD deployments are immutable SavingsUsdd ERC-4626 wrappers with no owner, role admin, pause, proxy, or upgrade path. Each wrapper's immutable asset() points to its chain-local native USDD deployment; deposit/mint creates shares only against deposited USDD and withdraw/redeem burns shares. The inherited USDD Join, GovActionsProxy, and owner controls are explicitly enumerated for both chains above and remain native parent issuance authority, not bridge machinery. Reconciliation review remains not-applicable because the mint path creates no off-chain reserve claim; local sUSDD issuance remains deposit-gated with on-chain parent accounting and no prudential regulator or independent attestor.
